description: This file defines the ImportServiceDelegate class, which is a Spring service responsible for delegating book import operations from external sources such as LibraryThing and Goodreads. It includes methods for importing books either from LibraryThing data or from Goodreads, utilizing respective import services.

classes.name: ImportServiceDelegate
classes.description: A Spring Service component that delegates book import tasks from different external sources.

methods.name: importFromLibraryThing
methods.description: Imports books from LibraryThing data by delegating to the LibraryThingBookImportService.

methods.name: importFromGoodreads
methods.description: Imports books from Goodreads, currently with placeholder implementation.
